name: tlib
description: Shared UI and utility library for FiveM resources

ignore.tests/lua/config-validate.lua: a tlib.config VALIDATOR fixture, not a config: its `licenseKey = 'abc123'` is a synthetic input proving a declared string key validates. The config rule matches it only because the basename contains `config`. Ignored by exact path rather than by widening the rule or by allowing `licenseKey` everywhere.

scripts.secrets:control: bun run scripts/secret-gate-control.ts && SECRETS_CONTROL=1 bunx --bun --package fengari-node-cli fengari scripts/run-lua-suite.lua tests/lua/secrets-overlay.lua
scripts.setup: bun run secrets:install-hooks && bun install && cd client/web && bun install
scripts.test:lua:control: bun run scripts/framerelay-control.ts && bun run scripts/runtimetxd-control.ts && bun run scripts/primitives-control.ts
scripts.typecheck:shared: cd shared/ts && bunx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --noEmit -p rage/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --noEmit -p rage-viewer/tsconfig.json
scripts.check:regression: bun run typecheck && bun run typecheck:shared && bun run typecheck:server && bun run check:imports && bun run check:classes && bun run check:classes:control && bun run check:boolattr && bun run check:runtime-state && bun run check:runtime-state:control && bun run check:deadfiles && bun run check:deadfiles:control && bun run check:comments && bun run check:comments:control && bun run secrets:provision:check && bun run secrets:control && bun run test && bun run test:dom && bun run test:dom:control && bun run test:lua && bun run test:lua:control
scripts.verify: bun run secrets:check && bun run lint && bun run check:regression && bun run build
